messages:
anya: Heads-up — after the merge of 0f3c9a2 (fused-attn + warmup tweak) we see p95 decode latency +30% on shortseq workloads in the canary fleet. Perf CI also flagged a regression: https://ci.internal/perf/54321 :frowning:

perf-ci: [ALERT] Canary 12/12 failed p95 threshold (baseline 42ms -> 56ms). Regression detected in job `decode-shortseq-canary`. See artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/54321

mike: Ugh. Did we change kernel selection heuristics in that CL or only the fused op lowering?

anya: The PR modified `kernel_selector::score()` to prefer fused matmul+attn for shortseq to reduce kernel launch overhead. Also adjusted warmup batch multiplier for small batches.

devon: Can we get a profile (pprof/flamegraph) from the canary traces? I want to see whether time is in matmul or in commit/warmup logic.

anya: Uploaded flamegraph to GCS: gs://perf-graphs/54321/flame.svg. Quick summary: ~60% of extra time is in `kv_cache::ensure_prefetch()` and ~25% in `fused_attn_kernel::launch()` (unexpected blocking).

lee: Hmm kv prefetch spike — could be thrashing due to the new warmup multiplier increasing concurrent prefetches. That would amplify memcopy/lock contention.

mike: Can you paste the short stack snippet?

anya: Sure:
```
# short stack (canary)
kv_cache::ensure_prefetch
kv_cache::reserve_prefetch_slots
batch_scheduler::start_batch
fused_attn_kernel::launch
runtime::submit_kernel
```

devon: The `reserve_prefetch_slots` spin looks new. We added a backpressure path that blocks when prefetch inflight > N. Maybe N is too low after we change batch warmup.

mike: Two options: revert the merge, or quick hotfix to lower warmup multiplier + increase prefetch window. Which is less risky?

lee: We can patch flags quickly. We already have runtime flags: `--warmup-multiplier` and `--max-prefetch-inflight`. Set warmup back to previous (1.0) and bump prefetch to 4.

anya: I'll push a canary config update to roll out those flags to 6 machines to validate.

perf-ci: [INFO] New canary run triggered by config change. Job: decode-shortseq-canary #54322

devon: Also start a bisect on the PR series to isolate whether the fused kernel lowering or the warmup tweak is the root cause. Use `git bisect start` between `main~5` and `0f3c9a2`. I can run perf harness overnight.

mike: If the small flag change stabilizes p95 below threshold, we can keep flags while we bisect and prepare a non-urgent revert if necessary.

anya: Canary #54322 initial results: p95 down to 44ms on the 6 machines after flags tweak. Looks promising :thumbsup:

lee: Great. Still run the bisect. If fused_attn is contributing, we need more kernel-level instrumentation (emit per-kernel queueing times).

devon: I'll add a lightweight tracepoint around `reserve_prefetch_slots` and `launch()` and re-run the bisect jobs. If the bisect points to the warmup tweak only, we revert that commit; otherwise revert fused lowering.
